name: Radiant Shatter
tooltip:
Radiant Shatter
2 sec cast
Disenchant a Radiant Shard, reducing it to 3 Eversinging Dust. The quality of Eversinging Dust produced is limited by the quality of Radiant Shard used, and is otherwise based on a combination of your Enchanting skill and Dust Deliverer specialization.

Profession: Enchanting (50)
